models.jobs: Live job openings shown on the board. Each job belongs to a company, has a monthly naira salary range or is marked confidential, and may carry EduBridge badges.
models.company: The hiring organisation embedded in each job: name, industry, size, location and a short about text shown in the job detail.
models.screeningQuestions: Optional questions an employer adds to a job. Candidates answer them in step 3 of the apply flow.
models.currentUser: The signed-in candidate viewing the board, with their saved CV and the jobs they have saved or already applied to. Null when a guest is browsing.
models.filterOptions: The choices available in each filter on the board: locations, job types, work modes, experience levels and monthly salary bands.

relationships: Each job belongs to one company, and a company can have several jobs on the board
Each job has zero or more screening questions
The current user has saved some jobs (savedJobIds) and applied to others (appliedJobIds), both referencing job ids
The current user's saved CV is the default choice in the apply flow

jobs.title: Data Analyst

company.name: Paystream Technologies
company.about: Paystream builds payment infrastructure for small and growing businesses across West Africa, processing millions of transactions every month.

jobs.summary: Turn transaction data into clear reports that help our merchant success team make better decisions.
jobs.description: You will join a small analytics team that supports sales, merchant success and product. Your day will involve cleaning data, building dashboards and answering questions like which merchants are at risk of leaving and which features drive repeat payments. This is a great first role for someone who has completed a data analysis program and wants to grow quickly with strong mentorship.
responsibilities: Build and maintain weekly dashboards for the merchant success team
Write SQL queries to answer ad hoc business questions
Clean and validate transaction data from several sources
Present findings to non-technical colleagues in plain language
requirements: Working knowledge of SQL and Excel or Google Sheets
Experience with a BI tool such as Power BI, Looker Studio or Tableau
Clear written and spoken communication
A degree, HND or completed data analysis program

screeningQuestions.question: Which BI tools have you used on a real project?
Are you able to work from our Lekki office two days a week?

jobs.title: Frontend Developer (React)

company.name: Lumen Health Nigeria
company.about: Lumen Health helps clinics across Nigeria manage patient records, appointments and billing from one simple platform.

jobs.summary: Build fast, accessible clinic software used by doctors and nurses every day.
jobs.description: We are looking for a frontend developer who cares about the people using the product. You will work closely with our designer and two backend engineers to ship features for clinic staff, many of whom use the app on low-cost Android phones with patchy connections. Performance and clarity matter more than flashy effects here.
responsibilities: Build new features in React and TypeScript
Improve load times on slow networks and low-end devices
Review pull requests and help keep the codebase tidy
Work with the designer to turn mockups into polished screens
requirements: At least 3 years of professional React experience
Strong TypeScript and modern CSS skills
Experience with testing tools such as Vitest or Jest
Comfortable working fully remotely with a small team
benefits: Fully remote with a monthly internet stipend
HMO for you and one dependant

screeningQuestions.question: How many years of professional React experience do you have?
Share a link to a project or code sample you are proud of.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer

company.name: Harbourline Consulting
company.about: Harbourline advises banks and insurers on digital transformation and builds custom software for their internal teams.

jobs.summary: Lead the design of secure backend services for enterprise banking clients.
jobs.description: EduBridge Academy is recruiting this role on behalf of Harbourline Consulting. You will lead backend work on projects for large financial institutions, owning service design, code quality and the technical relationship with client engineering teams. The role suits someone who enjoys mentoring and is comfortable explaining trade-offs to non-engineers. Projects typically run for six to twelve months, and you will usually be working on one main project at a time with support from two or three mid-level engineers. Security, auditability and reliability are central to everything we build, so experience in regulated industries is a strong advantage. You will also contribute to internal tools and help shape our engineering standards as the practice grows from twelve to twenty engineers over the next year.
responsibilities: Design and build backend services in Node.js or Go
Lead code reviews and mentor mid-level engineers
Work directly with client teams on architecture decisions
Set up monitoring, logging and security practices
requirements: At least 6 years of backend development experience
Strong experience with PostgreSQL and cloud platforms
Experience in banking, insurance or another regulated industry
Excellent communication with technical and non-technical people
benefits: Competitive salary shared at interview stage
HMO for you and your family

screeningQuestions.question: Have you worked on software for a bank or insurer?
What is your expected monthly salary in naira?
